verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Recording pause, retention policies and transcript redaction are adjacent data-handling controls, not opt-outs from product telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
